You greet people politely at any time of day.
Excuse me, where is the station?
The basic sentence: X は Y です
“X は Y です” = “X is Y”. は (read wa) marks what you’re talking about, and です politely ends the sentence.
To make a question, add か at the end: これは ほんですか。= Is this a book?
The verb always goes at the end of the sentence.
